speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception. The combination of vomiting, abdominal distension, failure to pass meconium, and the clinical suspicion of a "sausage-shaped" mass is highly specific for this condition in an infant. The X-ray findings of a dilated stomach with an air-fluid level and no distal gas confirm a proximal obstruction, which aligns with telescoping of the bowel. Immediate surgical consultation is required for potential reduction or resection.
